definitions.gloss: abstinence from alcohol; giving up drinking
definitions.explanation: The act of refraining from drinking alcohol, either temporarily or permanently, often for health reasons or personal discipline.
A law or regulation banning the sale or consumption of alcohol. Used historically to refer to alcohol prohibition movements or policies.

notes:
USAGE:
{禁酒|きんしゅ} is used as a noun and often paired with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to form the verb 'to abstain from alcohol.' The ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ form is common in everyday conversation about personal health choices.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {禁酒|きんしゅ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (abstain from alcohol)
- {禁酒|きんしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}める (start abstaining)
- {禁酒|きんしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ (continue abstaining)
- {禁酒|きんしゅ}{法|ほう} (prohibition law)
- {禁酒|きんしゅ}⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧ (temperance movement)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{断酒|だんしゅ} also means giving up alcohol but implies a firmer, more permanent commitment, often in the context of overcoming alcoholism. {禁酒|きんしゅ} can be temporary or permanent. ⟦{禁煙|きんえん}→禁煙：02644_kinen⟧ is the counterpart for quitting smoking.
